title: See it in your face. See it in your eye. Lazy idle little schemer.
html_source:
The editor reminds Stephen of the unjust pandying he received as a child by Father Dolan, depicted in A Portrait:

—Out here, Dedalus. Lazy little schemer. I see schemer in your face.

Evidently, the incident has weighed heavily on Stephen. Dolan will later appear as a hallucination in Circe:

FATHER DOLAN: Any boy want flogging? Broke his glasses? Lazy idle little schemer. See it in your eye.
